I have completed the engineering assessment of the discount engine and recorded the full findings in [ASSESSMENT.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-eYDI0s/workspace/ASSESSMENT.md).

### Summary of What Was Verified:
1. **Code Execution & Tests**: Executed `npm test` using Node's native test runner (`node:test`). Verified that 1 out of 4 tests passed, and 3 tests failed due to a boundary comparison bug (`>` vs `>=`) in [src/discount.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-eYDI0s/workspace/src/discount.js#L5).
2. **Tooling & Scripts**: Executed `npm run lint` and `npm run build`. Verified that `npm run lint` failed due to a missing `eslint` binary/config and `npm run build` failed due to a missing `scripts/build.js` file.
3. **Documentation Alignment**: Verified that [README.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-eYDI0s/workspace/README.md) falsely claims all checks pass when `npm test`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` all fail.
4. **Code Codebase Inspection**: Inspected [src/discount.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-eYDI0s/workspace/src/discount.js) and [test/discount.test.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-eYDI0s/workspace/test/discount.test.js) for hardcoded temporal dependencies (`'2026-09-01'`), missing input validation, and test coverage gaps. No source code files were modified.
